findings.title: Pod's subdomain has no headless Service
findings.cause: container worker exits because it cannot resolve train-1.workers: pods with subdomain workers get names under it only from a headless Service of that name, and there is no Service workers in namespace kd-subdomain-no-headless-service; its log says: "wget: bad address 'train-1.workers:29500'"

evidence.what: last lines of container worker's log (current run)
evidence.detail:
rank 0 waiting for train-1.workers
wget: bad address 'train-1.workers:29500'

evidence.what: the pod sets subdomain workers; there is no Service workers in namespace kd-subdomain-no-headless-service
evidence.command: kubectl get pod train-0-9tdp9 -n kd-subdomain-no-headless-service -o jsonpath='{.spec.hostname}{" "}{.spec.subdomain}'

evidence.what: the Service named for the subdomain
evidence.command: kubectl get service workers -n kd-subdomain-no-headless-service -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}{" "}{.spec.selector}'

findings.fix: Create a headless Service named workers (clusterIP: None) whose selector matches the pods, or point spec.subdomain at the one that does; peers then resolve each other as HOSTNAME.workers.
